title: Energy-Guided Transport for Projection-Free Physics-Informed Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2611.06711v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep generative models, particularly Flow Matching frameworks, have emerged as powerful tools for synthesizing complex physical systems. However, standard architectures remain purely statistically driven and agnostic to the underlying governing equations, often violating fundamental physical constraints during inference. Existing zero-shot approaches designed to enforce these constraints typically rely on rigid algebraic projections. While effective for sparse boundary conditions, applying such discrete geometric corrections to dense, full-domain PDEs may disrupt the probability path, \rev{potentially deviating from the learned manifold and introducing substantial computational overhead}. To address these challenges, we introduce Energy-Guided Transport, a novel training-free framework that formulates non-linear physical constraints as a smooth potential energy landscape. translated_title: 面向无投影物理信息流匹配的能量引导传输
translated_abstract: 深度生成模型，特别是流匹配框架，已成为合成复杂物理系统的强大工具。然而，标准架构仍然纯粹由统计驱动，对底层控制方程一无所知，在推理过程中常常违反基本物理约束。现有的旨在强制执行这些约束的零样本方法通常依赖于刚性的代数投影。虽然这类方法对稀疏边界条件有效，但将这种离散的几何校正应用于稠密的、覆盖全域的偏微分方程时，可能会破坏概率路径，导致偏离已学习的流形，并引入大量计算开销。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了能量引导传输，这是一种新颖的免训练框架，它将非线性物理约束表述为平滑的势能景观。我们的方法不是中断ODE积分过程，而是施加……
tldr: 提出了一种免训练的能量引导传输框架，将非线性物理约束建模为平滑势能场，无需离散投影即可在流匹配推理过程中保持物理一致性，并避免破坏概率路径和降低计算开销。
en_tdlr: A training-free Energy-Guided Transport framework that formulates non-linear physical constraints as a smooth potential energy landscape, enabling projection-free physics-informed flow matching without disrupting the probability path or incurring substantial computational overhead.
